faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 29th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech./M.S/M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering or an equivalent degree with at least 60% marks or 7.0 CGPA. Additionally, qualification in CSIR-UGC NET or GATE is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any research experience required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of two years of research experience after completing the qualifying degree is mandatory for all applicants applying for the Senior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 54,600/-.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for the IIT Gandhinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, making it accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow position at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow at IIT Gandhinagar is offered on a contractual basis as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. This recruitment is for candidates looking for opportunities in this region.
